Monologue: Fine night we are having here, friend. Shame you are unable to enjoy it.
I would say you are missing out, but for some reason, I don't believe that to be the case.
You are odder than most. More akin to our kind…but you are lacking the most important ingredient.
A husk with no engagement with this world. I doubt you rejected those folks out of just fear. Are you truly only interested in cooking?
Or was it perhaps just boredom? If so, maybe you and I are more alike than I thought.
You see, friend, I am here to learn more about "Verehn" on behalf of my…superiors. The Spoilage here is something they are greatly interested in.
I watch, just like you, of all the folks who are trapped in this city. When I act, it is to *experiment*.
You, my friend, will be my final subject. I will continue my research from afar, but there is no more fun to be had. This is goodbye, friend.
